q: Does this file handle a request or action that changes data without checking on the server that the caller is allowed to?
Does this file build a SQL query, shell command or file path by joining strings that include user-controlled input?
Does this file put user-controlled or fetched data into HTML as markup without escaping or sanitizing it?
Does this file compare secrets or tokens with == or === instead of a constant-time comparison, or put a token in a URL?
Does this file write secrets, tokens or full request bodies to a log without redacting them?
Does this file make a server-side request to a URL that a user can supply, without checking the host?
Is this a route component that lacks a loader for its data or an action for its updates?
Does this file create new objects, arrays or functions inline as props of a memoized child component?
Does this file show a blank area or a bare spinner while loading data, instead of a skeleton shaped like the content?
Does this file use an ARIA role or aria attribute on an element where a native HTML element would do the same job?
Does this file render a form control that has no associated label?
